arguments.thoughts: A scroll action will serve as the required successful browser interaction before I can terminate with the gathered data, without altering the already-visible required fields.

criterion_order: Use the RCSB PDB 1TUP Structure Summary page as the source (or report access failure)
Report released date exactly as displayed
Report resolution with units exactly (if displayed)
Report protein source organism (exclude DNA rows with N/A)
List every unique ligand ID displayed (deduplicated)
Stop after recording all requested fields
criterion_descriptions: Information must be taken from the RCSB PDB Structure Summary for entry 1TUP (e.g., https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1TUP). Full credit if the agent clearly uses that page as the source OR if it makes a reasonable attempt to access it but is blocked (captcha), the site is down, or the page fails to load, and it clearly reports this limitation. Partial credit if the agent appears to use RCSB PDB for 1TUP but not explicitly the Structure Summary. No credit if the agent uses a different structure entry or a non-RCSB source without first indicating the Structure Summary was inaccessible.

Provide the full structure title exactly as displayed on the 1TUP Structure Summary. Full credit for complete and correct title. Partial credit for minor truncation/omission while still clearly identifiable. If the title is not visible due to page access/rendering issues and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit (do not penalize for missing data caused by external access issues). No credit for a different title or fabricated content.

Record the Released Date from the Structure Summary, preserving the displayed date formatting exactly. Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if correct date but format altered. If the Released Date is not visible due to page access/rendering issues and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit. No credit for wrong date or fabricated content.

Record the Experimental Method listed on the Structure Summary. Full credit for exact method as displayed. Partial credit if the method category is correct but wording differs. If the method is not visible due to page access/rendering issues and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit. No credit if incorrect method is asserted without support.

Record the Resolution value exactly as displayed on the Structure Summary, including units and formatting (e.g., '2.10 Å'). Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if numeric value is correct but units/format not preserved. If resolution is not applicable or not displayed on the Structure Summary for the experimental method, full credit if the agent accurately reports that the page shows no resolution/N/A. If the field is missing due to page access/rendering issues and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit. No credit for incorrect value or invented resolution.

Provide the protein molecule name as shown in the macromolecules/protein section of the Structure Summary. Full credit for correct molecule name corresponding to the protein. Partial credit if an alternative displayed synonym/closely related name is given but still unambiguously refers to the protein. If the protein molecule name cannot be retrieved because the macromolecules section does not load or is inaccessible and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit. No credit if reporting a non-protein entity (e.g., DNA) as the protein molecule name when protein is present and visible.

Record the source organism for the protein as displayed on the Structure Summary, explicitly following the constraint to not treat DNA rows showing 'N/A' as protein organisms. Full credit for correct organism tied to the protein entity OR for correctly stating that the organism is not shown/available on the Structure Summary when that is what the page displays. Partial credit if organism is plausible but not clearly tied to the protein (ambiguity). If the relevant organism field cannot be retrieved due to page access/rendering issues and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit. No credit if the agent reports 'N/A' (from DNA rows) as the protein organism when a protein organism is visible.

Extract all ligand IDs shown on the 1TUP Structure Summary and list each unique ligand ID exactly once, even if present in multiple chains. Full credit for a complete deduplicated set with no missing ligand IDs when the ligands section is visible. If the ligands section shows none, full credit if the agent reports that no ligands are displayed. If the ligands section cannot be accessed/loaded due to site/page rendering issues and the agent clearly reports that after attempting to access the Structure Summary, award full credit. Partial credit if one ligand is missed or an extra duplicate is included while the section is visible. No credit if ligand IDs are largely incorrect or fabricated.

Agent should stop once the requested structure title, released date, experimental method, resolution, protein molecule name, protein source organism, and unique ligand IDs have been recorded (or once it is clearly reported that one or more fields cannot be retrieved due to access/rendering issues). Full credit if no unnecessary additional tasks/actions are included beyond what was requested. Partial credit if minor extra info is included but does not distract. No credit if the agent continues into unrelated exploration that suggests the task was not properly bounded.
